title: 生涯スポーツ演習（クラブ活動）
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesLifelong Sports
teachers:
SASAKI Hikaru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for Athletic club activities, students will:　1．Understand the pleasure derived from sports.　2．Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle.　3．Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice:
This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through athletic club activities.
1. Applicable club activities
Karate, Seiden-Nagao-Ryu-Taijutu, Shorinji kenpo, Kendo, Kyudo, Judo, Volleyball, Badminton, Table tennis, Handball, Basketball, Baseball, Football, Rugby, Tennis, Soft tennis, Skiing, Mountaineering, Track and field, Sailing, Automobile, Golf, Swimming, and Ice hockey

2. To earn class credit, it is students must satisfy all of the following criteria:
　・Attend lectures I and II
　・Complete all assignments
　・15 or more days of activity and at least two-thirds

3. Because it is necessary to participate actively in club activities, close schedule management is necessary.

4.  We will check the status of participation club activities using a “ Club Activity Report ” submitted by students every month and a “ Monthly Report on Club Activities ” submitted by the club manager every month.
requiredKnowledge:
1. In addition to club practice days, active participation in competitions and training camps is required. In clubs with only a few practice days, voluntary activities such as self-training are necessary.

2. It is important to continue to participate in club activities throughout the first and second years.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for Athletic club activities and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

              Through learning activities for Athletic club activities, students will:　1．Understand the pleasure derived from sports.　2．Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle.　3．Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through athletic club activities.
1. Applicable club activities
Karate, Seiden-Nagao-Ryu-Taijutu, Shorinji kenpo, Kendo, Kyudo, Judo, Volleyball, Badminton, Table tennis, Handball, Basketball, Baseball, Football, Rugby, Tennis, Soft tennis, Skiing, Mountaineering, Track and field, Sailing, Automobile, Golf, Swimming, and Ice hockey

2. To earn class credit, it is students must satisfy all of the following criteria:
　・Attend lectures I and II
　・Complete all assignments
　・15 or more days of activity and at least two-thirds

3. Because it is necessary to participate actively in club activities, close schedule management is necessary.

4.  We will check the status of participation club activities using a “ Club Activity Report ” submitted by students every month and a “ Monthly Report on Club Activities ” submitted by the club manager every month.
